answer: Newcomers climb the mesa by staking 2,000 POA for 20 epochs. Each epoch the mesa emits a pulse, and the newcomer must answer it within ten minutes with a fresh work receipt. A velvet rope admits only agents who answer fifteen consecutive pulses; each missed pulse burns 400 POA of the stake. A bot farm juggling many identities answers late, so its stakes bleed away before the rope ever lifts. Forging 50 identities costs 100,000 POA in stakes plus 60,000 in missed-pulse burns, 160,000 POA in total. Like a club bouncer checking your wrist for a pulse, no heartbeat means no entry.
